subject.title: [Feature]: Collapsible messages in Control UI chat

question: Should Control UI add inline collapsible assistant message bubbles for ordinary long Markdown, and what default threshold/interaction should it use alongside the existing side reader?
rationale: Source inspection shows the requested capability is still missing, but the default collapse threshold, streaming behavior, code-block treatment, and collapse-all affordance are product choices rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Add Bounded Inline Disclosure
options.body: Define a line/height threshold for completed assistant Markdown, keep the latest/streaming response readable, and add focused tests for show-more/show-less without changing history payload caps.

options.title: Use Side Reader Only
options.body: Treat the existing side reader as the long-message affordance and close or narrow this request after documenting that inline collapse is not planned.

options.title: Defer Until Broader Chat UX Pass
options.body: Leave this open but block implementation until maintainers decide the full chat-bubble, code-block, and mobile disclosure model together.

recommendation.title: Add Bounded Inline Disclosure
recommendation.body: Define a line/height threshold for completed assistant Markdown, keep the latest/streaming response readable, and add focused tests for show-more/show-less without changing history payload caps.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-main routing signal for the moved Control UI chat component and docs paths that would absorb or review the implementation.
